elements.element: Cap applies mutually to each Party's aggregate liability
elements.evidence: "each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed"

elements.element: Fee limb measured as fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim
elements.evidence: "the Fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim" — event anchor, and defined capital-F "Fees" excludes taxes, expenses, implementation charges

elements.element: Second limb of USD 1,000,000 with a greater-of operator

elements.evidence: No exclusion of indirect, consequential, incidental or special damages appears anywhere in 21.1 or 21.3 as rendered

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for breach of confidentiality, data protection and security obligations
elements.evidence: "Except for Excluded Claims, which are not subject to this limitation"; 21.3 "breach of confidentiality, data-protection, or security obligations"
21.3 "its indemnification obligations" read with "Except for Excluded Claims"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for gross negligence, wilful misconduct and fraud
Uncapped carve-out for infringement of the other party's IP
elements.evidence: 21.3 "infringement or misappropriation of the other Party's intellectual property"

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not "damages" for cap purposes
elements.evidence: "Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees for conforming Services is not damages" — narrower than Customer's payment obligations generally
"each Party's total aggregate liability ... shall not exceed the greater of (a) the Fees paid or payable ... in the twelve (12) months"

elements.element: Carve-outs at least for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct
elements.evidence: "Except for Excluded Claims, which are not subject to this limitation" together with the 21.3 list

offending_extra_words: arising out of or relating to this Agreement
reasons: Preferred level is incomplete: the fee limb is anchored to "the event giving rise to the claim" rather than the claim, and uses the defined capital-F "Fees" (which excludes taxes, expenses and implementation charges), so it does not deliver "fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim".
No mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages was inserted, a required preferred element that is absent from the document as rendered.

The "not damages" saving is limited to "undisputed Fees for conforming Services" and was left untouched; the preferred position requires Customer's payment obligations generally to sit outside the cap.

Minimality fails: the rewrite expands 19 words to 59 (ratio 3.11) with unnecessary boilerplate ("arising out of or relating to this Agreement", "total", "by Customer under this Agreement") when replacing the cap basis and deleting "without exception" would suffice.
Intent is preserved: 21.3's Excluded Claims and the payment-obligation sentence remain effective and the carve-out cross-reference is coherent; the clause sits materially at or above the fallback.
